statement: For any canonical ordinary CNF state with at most five clauses, if v0.5 selects a minimum-incidence live pivot and performs exact ordinary elimination, the canonical output has at most five clauses. Consequently every continuing ordinary elimination from an m<=5 state has raw clause count<=5 and RAW_UNITS<=1+5n before canonicalization, where n is the number of live variables before the step.
proof: Let m<=5 and let d=p+q be the incidence degree of the selected minimum-incidence pivot. Raw clause count is at most m-d+p*q before tautology removal, duplicate suppression and subsumption.
If d<=4 then p*q<=floor(d^2/4). Hence m-d+p*q<=5-d+floor(d^2/4)<=5 for d=0,1,2,3,4.

The only remaining case is d=5. Since d is the minimum live-variable incidence and no variable can occur in more than m<=5 clauses, d=5 forces m=5 and every live variable to occur in all five clauses.
Therefore every one of the five clauses contains every live variable exactly once and is a full-width sign vector.

For a positive-pivot parent and a negative-pivot parent, the resolvent is non-tautological only when their signs agree on every nonpivot variable; otherwise some y and -y both occur in the merged tail.

Because the CNF is canonical and has no duplicate clauses, a fixed positive parent tail can match at most one negative parent tail and vice versa. Thus the number of non-tautological resolvents is at most min(p,q)<=2; there are no retained clauses because d=m=5.
Hence d=5 actually produces at most two raw non-tautological clauses, and therefore at most five canonical clauses.
The invariant follows by induction over continuing ordinary eliminations under the same minimum-incidence selector.
After eliminating one variable from an n-live-variable state, every raw output clause has width at most n-1. With at most five raw clauses, state_units<=1+5*(1+n-1)=1+5n.
next_exact_target: Regression-check the arithmetic d<=4 cases and exhaustive finite full-width d=5 sign-vector fixtures; then use the proved invariant only where an exact transition first reaches m<=5.
